description: Ranks companies currently hiring on Level by how central AI is to their open roles: the average AI rating (0-100) of their live listings. This is a Level-specific aggregation, not a third-party ranking. See the returned `method` field for the exact rule. Companies with too few live listings, and known job-board republishers, are excluded.

min_jobs.description: Minimum number of live listings required to be ranked (default 10).

name: list_companies_by_ai_level
title: Companies hiring on Level, by AI level
